chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him, 'Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) pray facing Bayt Al-Maqdis?' He said, 'Yes.' So I said, 'Did he make the Ka'bah behind his back?' He said, 'As for when he was in Makkah, no; and as for when he emigrated to Al-Madinah, yes, until he was turned towards the Ka'bah.'
ai.seo_question: When did the Prophet Muhammad change his prayer direction from Jerusalem to the Ka'bah?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the specific historical timeline of the Qiblah transition, confirming that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) prayed towards Bayt Al-Maqdis both during his time in Makkah and after migrating to Al-Madinah. The shift to facing the Ka'bah occurred only after the divine command was revealed in Al-Madinah, a detail that underscores the gradual nature of legislative changes in early Islam. This context is crucial for understanding the jurisprudential basis for praying in the direction of the Ka'bah as the permanent Qiblah for the Muslim community.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws, ‘Did Rasool-Allahsaww used to pray Salāt (facing) towards Bayt Al-Maqdis?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’. So I said, ‘Did hesaww make the Kabah to be behind hissaww back?’ So heasws said: ‘As for when hesaww was in Makkah, so no, and as for when hesaww had emigrated to Al-Medina, so yes, until hesaww turned towards the Kabah (permanently)’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘Did the Messenger of Allah perform Salah (prayer) facing Bayt al-Maqdis?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘Yes, he did so.’
I then asked, ‘Would he turn his back toward al-Ka‘bah?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘When in Makkah he did not do so; but when he migrated to al-Madinah, he did so until he turned to al-Ka‘bah.’”
